prompt:
Using the draft-outreach skill's synthesis process (read the skill and its references), draft a cold LinkedIn opener for this lead. Don't touch the Google Sheet or run sheets_client.py — just output the drafted opener text (or SKIP — reason) to a file.

NAME: Priya Raman
RAW_NOTES: Runs a 22-person full-service agency in Bangalore — SEO, paid social, content, and web dev all in-house, one team per discipline. LinkedIn About: "we handle it all under one roof so you don't have to juggle five vendors." Site has a contact form and a Calendly booking link for discovery calls; no live chat widget anywhere. No recent LinkedIn posts. Team page lists 22 people, roughly even split across the four service lines.
LAST_SENT: (none — this is the initial DM)

assertions.text: Picks one specific signal, not a combination of several
Ends in a question, not a value-prop statement
Contains no permission-asking language (would it be okay, curious if, no worries if not)
Lowercase/casual register, short lines, no corporate phrasing
Could not have been sent unedited to 500 other agencies (passes the personalization bar)
